quote.hr: Game Changer konferencija otkriva sve o tech budućnosti.
quote.en: Game Changer conference reveals everything about the tech future.

quote.hr: Stigao je Game Changer, projekt koji će Hrvatsku staviti na kartu digitalnih destinacija.
quote.en: Game Changer has arrived — a project that will put Croatia on the map of digital destinations.

quote.hr: Zagreb je domaćin prve poslovne konferencije o gamingu i metaversu.
quote.en: Zagreb is hosting the first business conference on gaming and the metaverse.

quote.hr: U Zagrebu se održala prva gaming i metaverse poslovna konferencija — Game Changer.
quote.en: The first gaming and metaverse business conference, Game Changer, took place in Zagreb.

quote.hr: Ako mislite da je ‘gejmanje’ trkeljanje u prazno u teškoj ste zabludi.
quote.en: If you think gaming is a waste of time, you are badly mistaken.

quote.hr: Zagreb je domaćin prve poslovne konferencije o gamingu i metaverseu koja će okupiti više od 60 stručnjaka na jednom mjestu!
quote.en: Zagreb hosts the first business conference on gaming and the metaverse, bringing together more than 60 experts in one place!

quote.hr: Prva velika gaming / Web3 & metaverse konferencija u Hrvatskoj.
quote.en: The first major gaming / Web3 & metaverse conference in Croatia.

quote.hr: Novac je tamo gdje su ljudi, u digitalnoj sferi.
quote.en: Money is where the people are — in the digital sphere.
